traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Krameriaceae: leaves alternate; leaves usually simple, rarely compound; margins entire; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody or herbaceous; flowers solitary or in racemes; flowers zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit achene; stamens (3-) 4; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Krameriaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 305, 306, family Krameriaceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral; read as "spiral".

traits.fruit_type.note: Simpson (2019) p. 305-306: a dry, one-seeded, prickly nut, sometimes a capsule. Watson and Dallwitz's DELTA gave achene; both are dry and do not open, and the round prickly fruit reads as a nut. Jay 2026-10-15 ~06:32Z: "go with your recommendations on disagreements".
